facts.fact: The authors say Cameroon enacted Law No. 2024/017 Relating to Personal Data Protection on 23 December 2024, enforceable against controllers and processors after an 18-month grace period from enactment.
facts.system: Law No. 2024/017 Relating to Personal Data Protection

facts.fact: The authors say the Act provides for a Personal Data Protection Authority, which is still to be established.
The authors say the Act is to be complemented by regulations on implementation, retention, security measures and authorisations, not yet issued.
facts.system: Law No. 2024/017 Relating to Personal Data Protection
